summary: npm package shipping only an obfuscated phishing-themed HTML page with no executable entrypoint
details: Package contains only index.html and a package.json declaring main: index.html. The HTML is a Cloudflare Turnstile 'Just a moment...' lookalike page carrying a heavily obfuscated inline script (IIFE with _0x-style identifiers at line 183). There are no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts, no JavaScript source, and HTML cannot be require()'d, so installing or importing this package does not execute code on the installer's machine. The shape is consistent with abuse of the npm registry as static-asset hosting (e.g. serving the HTML via a public CDN mirror such as unpkg or jsDelivr) rather than a supply-chain attack against developers who install the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
